candidates.name: Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: Title numbers and UPRNs are separate identifiers linked only where HMLR can make a relationship between an AddressBase address and title number.
Title number is a unique identifier that can link HMLR datasets.
Duplicate address situations can produce a title-number-only record and a separate UPRN-only record.
A title number can affect many properties and all affecting UPRNs may be associated.
semantic_limits: UPRN presence, absence or address similarity must not be used to invent or replace INSPIRE polygon geometry.

candidates.name: Title Descriptor dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: The Title Descriptor dataset provides estate interest, class of title and registered status for registered estates and interests.
Each registered estate or interest has a unique title number.
An application awaiting registration can have an associated title number but no estate or class information.
The title number links the descriptor dataset to other HMLR data products.
semantic_limits: Descriptor attributes are registration metadata and do not constitute polygon coordinates, exact legal boundary evidence or terrain elevation.
